title: A Garment Can Outlive Its File
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: A Garment Can Outlive Its File: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: A garment and its digital record are interdependent preservation systems: the object carries material evidence the file cannot feel, while the file carries context the object cannot state.
frames.alt: Title plate for A Garment Can Outlive Its File.
frames.treatment: typography, rule, folio and domain color only

frames.caption: A garment record becomes institutional evidence when material, date, maker, identifier, and rights remain attached.
frames.alt: Eighteenth-century French silk dress with a fitted bodice and full skirt, from The Metropolitan Museum of Art collection.
frames.treatment: local display and download with attached credit

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 01 · IDENTIFY — Can object and file find each other?. Assign stable identifiers to garment, component, container, digital folder, preservation copy, image, and related record; never rely on filename or shelf memory alone.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can object and file find each other? within A Garment Can Outlive Its File.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · DESCRIBE — What evidence belongs to each medium?. Record physical material, construction, wear and condition separately from file provenance, format, metadata, rights, version, and fixity. Link without collapsing.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what evidence belongs to each medium? within A Garment Can Outlive Its File.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · CARE — What threatens survival?. Assess handling, light, pests, humidity, storage materials, damage, hardware, software, format, bit integrity, access, vendor, and backup with appropriate specialists.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what threatens survival? within A Garment Can Outlive Its File.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · USE — How will access avoid harm?. Define handling, digitization, research, display, reproduction, privacy, cultural restriction, loan, treatment, and correction rules; record every intervention.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping how will access avoid harm? within A Garment Can Outlive Its File.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields
